notes.title: Checkpoint Update
notes.notes:
There has been a lot of feedback saying that VITAL is a bit unforgiving, and that having to restart the whole level when you die is frustrating.

To fix this we have introduced a checkpoints system that will teleport the player if they die or fall into the void.

We hope this will make your gaming experience a lot less tedious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35893934/c03ec863494db516399a6b2bf503ec32bd5df6ed.gif[/img]

notes.title: VITAL Major Update!
notes.notes:
This patch contains major changes to VITAL. The biggest changes are the game's graphical. Colors are now more vibrant and the vegetation has become more detailed. There has also been some QoL updates, in the list below I will present the most prominent changes and fixes.


[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support
[*] Updated graphics
[*] Better vegetation (New and more trees)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35893934/cfadbd9b9dafeba12cc97e93b647072c488b8516.png[/img]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The player now has decreased acceleration, meaning that precision movement is now easier.
[*] The player can now jump 30 units higher, this should make some platforming easier and jump on cubes easier as well
[*] Higher cube mass and less angular physics, this should help with some precision placement
[*] The cube is now positioned in the center and transparent to make it easier for precision placement
[*] The cube will now also reflect lasers while the player is holding the cube, this should also make precision aiming easier
[*] Removed annoying end part from level 13
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Translucent materials have been overhauled and should be less taxing on low end GPUs
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35893934/f5f6d2f22821615bea4092c82d4908452487799e.jpg[/img]


Until next time
Frozen Helm out

notes.title: Just Arms
notes.notes:
Frozen Helm is happy to announce Just Arms!

Just Arms is a physics-based platformer with limited controls.

You take the role as an unwavering knight who lost his legs in a terrible fall. 
Journey to the top of the world to find the powerful witch so she can restore your former glory.

Some of just arms features

[list]
[*] Challenging and addicting gameplay
[*] Huge world with lore and interesting characters
[*] Different areas, such as forest, winter and town area
[*] Each area presents a different challenge
[*] Free for all 4 player multiplayer
[*] Unlockable skins
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Colorful and happy graphics
[*] Select between normal shader and toon shader
[/list]

The game will come to early access later this february

Check out the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1215750/Just_Arms]here[/url]

notes.title: VITAL Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
This is the third patch for VITAL.

This patch contains fixes, changes and removal of unwanted items.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Spelling errors on one of the tutorial notes.
[*] Using the Orb of Elasticity to push down pressure plates will no longer be exploitable.
[*]There were still issues with the game starting in VR mode, these have now been fixed and the game should never try to start as a VR app.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The recharge timer of the eyes on level 13 will now reset once you're out of sight making it more predictable.
[*] Removed some of insta kill spikes at the end of the last level.
[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed unused bloodnote on level 13.
[*] Removed a redundant Orb of Elasticity on level 17.
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Good ending achivement seems to not trigger sometimes.
[/list]

Until next time
Frozen Helm out

notes.title: VITAL patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This is the second patch for VITAL.

It contains changes to the void walker, improvements to levels and visibility for the orb of gravity

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 7 have been updated with railings to stand when you ride the platform to the exit.
[*] Level 9 has been changed so you only need on bounce jump to  cross over to the other side.
[*] Level 10 closes the gap between floating island and the start area, this should ease some frustration.
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] The void walker now screams when he detects the player, this should make it easier for the players to know if they are detected or not.
[*] The void walkers attack speed has been decreased by 12,5%
[*] The orb of gravity has a new gravity effect, this should increase the visiblity when using at longer distances
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35893934/972c52ba46f76aa0f7fdd71703a6cfe8d7f2a43b.jpg[/img]

Until next time
Frozen Helm out

notes.title: VITAL Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Small but crucial hotfix.

It was reported that the lasers weren't working properly and thus stopping the player from progressing.

This has now been fixed.

Sorry for this inconvenience and I wish you all a happy holiday.

notes.title: VITAL Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
This is the first official patch for VITAL.

It contains some small changes and improvements.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] VITAL should no longer start as an oculus app if you have oculus installed and plugged in
[*] You should no longer get stuck when expanding the first crystal on level 5
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the engine to the latest version of UE 4.24
[*] Added some supports to the floating platform on level 8 to ease the frustration off falling off
[*] The eyes on level 13 now have longer charge time between shots
[*] Removed unused content making the game file size smaller
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a level select option in the main menu (you can skip tutorial levels but exiting the level and going to the main menu)
[/list]
[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the eyes on level 5 since the caused more frustration that being a puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: VITAL Demo update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The reception of the VITAL demo has been great and there has been tons of feedback!

Here are some of changes and fixes.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse look not working if settings hasn't been applied
[*] WASD is the default movement keys instead of arrow keys
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Orb of Destruction no longer kills the player
[*] Death sound has been removed and replaced with something more suitable
[*] Removed hard to see spikes that cause a lot of cheap deaths
[*] Pressing any key will remove the intro from the first level
[/list]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small tutorial at the start of level one
[*] New and better looking explosion
[*] Added the ability to rebind keys in the ingame menu
[/list]

I hope you enjoy these small changes
Frozen helm over and out
